subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on BMW engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the N13 across all 1 model applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The N13 appears exclusively in the F20/F21 1 Series, in 116i and 118i form. It was BMW's entry-level petrol engine for this generation.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Timing chain (where required), bearings, and gaskets as standard on every rebuild.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: No widely-reported pattern is confirmed for the N13. We don't treat this engine as having one universal failure mode; diagnosis is required to establish whether an engine needs repair, rebuild or replacement.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page - they'll be added once a documented set of completed N13 rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.
